name: lovable-recon-monorepo
description: Recon - cost/runtime/waste recon + cleanup for Lovable Cloud portfolios. Sibling of lovable-audit (security).

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['packages/core/dist','packages/profile-cost/dist','packages/benchmarks/dist','packages/recon/dist']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nxlv-ai/lovable-core && npm run build -w @nxlv-ai/lovable-profile-cost && npm run build -w @nxlv-ai/lovable-benchmarks && npm run build -w @nxlv-ai/lovable-recon
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
